records.title: Rotonde Dome Satchel
records.shortDescription: A rounded dome satchel in deep bordeaux grained leather.
records.description: A softly domed satchel in bordeaux grained leather, built on a flat structured base. A two-way gold zip runs over the top, and two rolled handles sit on stitched diamond tabs. A detachable, adjustable strap lets it go from hand to crossbody.
details: Rolled top handles on diamond tabs
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Keep away from water, direct heat and prolonged sunlight.

specifications.Interior: One zip pocket, two slip pockets

records.title: Serif S-Lock Top-Handle
records.shortDescription: A blush top-handle bag closed with a sculpted gold S turn-lock.
records.description: A neat trapezoid top-handle in soft blush leather. The curved front flap closes with a sculpted gold S turn-lock, a nod to the Super Mimic mark. A padded top handle and a detachable shoulder strap make it a day-to-evening piece.
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Light colours can take on dye from denim; avoid prolonged contact.

records.title: Atelier Tab Tote
records.shortDescription: A structured taupe tote with a gold-bar tab closure.
records.description: A roomy, structured tote in taupe pebbled leather with clean side gussets. A leather tab with a slim gold bar closes the centre, two rolled handles sit on teardrop tabs, and a detachable strap is included for crossbody wear.
details: Leather tab closure with gold bar
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store stuffed and in the dust bag provided.
Keep away from water, direct heat and prolonged sunlight.

records.title: Orbe Turn-Lock Shoulder Bag
records.shortDescription: A black flap shoulder bag with a round gold turn-lock and chain strap.
records.description: A compact flap bag in black grained leather that sits close under the arm. A round gold turn-lock closes the flap. Wear it on the leather shoulder strap, or switch to the detachable gold chain for a longer crossbody drop.
care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Store flat in the dust bag provided.
Wipe the chain with a dry cloth to keep its shine.
